meta.title: Howard County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Howard County's 2026 budget, adopted by Ordinance 2025-16, as filed with the state. Amounts are the 2026 budget column, checked against the county's 2026 totals sheets. The general fund includes $218,790 in two transfer lines to outside budgets.
